title: lolium multiflorum var. siculum
intro: Lolium multiflorum var. siculum, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a type of perennial grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional herbal medicine to promote relaxation and reduce stress. The health benefits of Italian ryegrass include its potential to lower blood pressure, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are known to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anxiolytic properties.
